slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the goal to minimize the total hours worked by the 4 selected workers, or is there a different objective (e.g., minimize the hours of the busiest worker, or meet a deadline)?

slot_scores.name: worker_at_most_one_task_constraint
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Can a single selected worker be assigned more than one of the four tasks, or must each selected worker take at most one task?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent directly asked whether a worker can take multiple tasks or at most one, covering the exact-one-task constraint.
